Query:
WITH ranked AS (
            SELECT
                customer_id,
                days_since_last_purchase, customer_tenure_days, purchase_frequency_30d, purchase_frequency_90d, purchase_frequency_180d, avg_order_value, total_spend_90d, total_lifetime_value, avg_basket_size_6m, category_diversity_score, online_to_store_ratio,
                churn_label,
                loyalty_tier,
                event_time,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY customer_id
                    ORDER BY event_time DESC, write_time DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM "northstar_dev_customer_features_1792006018"
            WHERE event_time BETWEEN 1767225600.0 AND 1798761600.0
              AND NOT is_deleted
        )
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            days_since_last_purchase, customer_tenure_days, purchase_frequency_30d, purchase_frequency_90d, purchase_frequency_180d, avg_order_value, total_spend_90d, total_lifetime_value, avg_basket_size_6m, category_diversity_score, online_to_store_ratio,
            churn_label,
            loyalty_tier
        FROM ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
        ORDER BY customer_id
